transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in a bookkeeping system to ensure accurate financial records and prevent data loss. Requirements SAF-01 and SAF-02 ensure data integrity and adherence to double-entry principles, while SAF-03 mandates a robust audit trail for accountability. SAF-04 and SAF-05 focus on fault tolerance and safe degradation, allowing users to access essential functionalities during outages. SAF-06 and SAF-07 emphasize the importance of validating currency conversions and regular backups to prevent discrepancies and data loss. These requirements collectively ensure a reliable and safe system for users.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is crucial for a bookkeeping system to ensure users can access and process financial data swiftly. Together, these requirements optimize system performance without compromising safety or trustworthiness.

transcript.statement: Ethical and compliance considerations are vital for a bookkeeping system to ensure accountability and fairness. requirements.text: The system shall ensure accurate recording of financial transactions to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall maintain a merged audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 5 years.
The system shall provide efficient error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring users can access essential functionalities during outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
The system shall ensure all financial transactions are processed within 3 seconds with mandatory safety checks.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 7 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions with safety checks.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by 30% compared to traditional methods.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption during data processing.
The system shall provide multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates to ensure fairness in international transactions.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their roles.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall log all user access and modifications to data, retaining logs for review.
The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers to maintain a transparent audit trail.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: Merging audit trail requirements eliminates redundancy while maintaining necessary logging functionalities.
Relaxing processing times while ensuring safety checks allows for both efficiency and safety.
Thorough error handling and currency validation may still introduce latency that conflicts with performance targets.
Strict user access controls may conflict with role-based access control, complicating user management.
